segments.transcript: I have a friend of mine who sold his company for $240 million. And what's crazy is that 24 hours before selling the business for $240 million, they thought the price was $140 million. It came up a hundred million in the last 24 hours. It's insane.

Two buyers absolutely wanted this particular business. They had a strategic reason to acquire it, and they didn't want anyone else having it. And at the last minute, it went 140, 160, 180, 200, 220, 240.
He said, it took me 15 years to build a $140 million business, and it took 24 hours to make the next $100 million.
